review.brief_reason: The original expression is a product of two exponentials: exp(A)*exp(B) where A contains the x4 and x3 terms and B contains the x1 and nested exp terms. The proposed simplification merges them into a single exp(A+B). Under real-valued semantics, exp(A)*exp(B) = exp(A+B) exactly, so the transformation is mathematically equivalent. All variables (x1 through x5) retain their fixed input-column identity and coefficients. The domain is all real numbers for all variables in both expressions, and operator semantics (exp, multiplication, addition, power) are preserved. The simplification is marginally simpler by combining two exp calls into one.
